extract_notes: FY2021 10-K (filed 2022-03-24) is light on specific Pentagon PE numbers — typical of early post-SPAC space-systems companies that don't yet have prime contracts on numbered RDT&E PEs. Disclosure leans on broad agency-name customers (DoD, DARPA, NRO, Space Force Space Systems Command) rather than specific PE-numbered programs. STP-S30 is the most specific named Pentagon program; SDA Tracking Layer T3 (cohort metadata) is forward / not booked. NSSL is named but only as a competitive aspiration, not a held contract.
